scope: Reading of the frozen v2 print mesh in its intended modeled assembly. The photos do not establish every photographed axial orientation.
finding: The central bridge is at the lowered spring-root plane, below the entire admitted neck circle. The neck cut misses the bridge, leaving no conforming neck lip. Only the larger body cut produces a shallow scallop. Zero hardware intersection did not establish hardware retention.
next_design: Keep the retaining body/neck lip independent of the spring-root height; inspect actual neck and shoulder capture, axial play and vertical play. Review intermediate leaf thickness and the root transition after the remaining physical results arrive.
